ranked_facts.why: The presence of 35% blasts in the leukocyte count is more consistent with a myeloid neoplasm, such as acute myelogenous leukemia, than with a lymphoid neoplasm, making B1 a more likely candidate than B2.
The full spectrum of maturing myeloid cells on smear is a characteristic feature of myeloid neoplasms, which supports B1 over B2.
